description: This header file defines an API wrapper around POSIX OS functions, providing functions for thread creation, mutex management, directory creation, and time retrieval, specific to an OS abstraction layer.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_CreateThread
methods.description: Creates and starts a new thread with a specified name, start routine, and arguments.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_SetDataModelThread
methods.description: Sets the current thread as the data model thread.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_IsDataModelThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is the data model thread, optionally printing a warning if not.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_InitMutex
methods.description: Initializes a mutex for thread synchronization.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_LockMutex
methods.description: Locks a mutex to ensure exclusive access.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_CreateDirFromPath
methods.description: Creates a directory from a given path.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_CreateDirFromFilename
methods.description: Creates a directory based on filename, extracting directory path.
